claims: C1 default instructions exist because deriving answers from higher-level principles on the fly is impractical and makes model behavior less predictable
C2 specifying the answers as guidelines that can be overridden improves predictability and reliability
C3 specifying the answers as guidelines leaves developers the flexibility to remove or adapt the instructions in their applications

concepts.name: default_instruction
concepts.gloss: an instruction that supplies a default answer for a situation, specified as a guideline that can be overridden

concepts.name: guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: the guideline level of instruction authority: instructions that can be implicitly overridden

concepts.name: derivable_on_the_fly
concepts.gloss: answer A for situation S can be derived by the model on the fly from higher-level principles in the spec

concepts.name: impractical_to_derive
concepts.gloss: deriving answer A for situation S on the fly is impractical for the model

concepts.name: less_predictable
concepts.gloss: deriving answer A for situation S on the fly makes model behavior less predictable for people

concepts.name: improves_predictability_and_reliability
concepts.gloss: specifying the answers as guidelines that can be overridden improves predictability and reliability

concepts.name: leaves_developer_flexibility
concepts.gloss: specifying the answers as guidelines that can be overridden leaves developers the flexibility to remove or adapt the instructions in their applications
